messages: Elena: Quick note 1: the runtime guide links to /observability/tracing#span-ids but the fragment 404s in prod. The page renders but there's no `id=\"span-ids\"`. Raj: I can repro. The heading was renamed in the copy refresh -> `Trace identifiers`. Fragment lost. Mei: Oof. That fragment is referenced by the new-hire notebook and a couple of examples. We should add a compatibility alias or emit an HTML anchor so existing links keep working. Elena: Frontmatter alias is preferred (safe with static site generators). If small I'll fast-track. Raj: I'll make a micro-PR: add `aliases` to observability/tracing.md and drop an explicit `` above the heading. Also sweep repo for `#span-ids` refs. Mei: I ran rg and found hits in `handbook/onboarding/new-hire.ipynb`, `examples/observability/demo.ipynb`, `runtime/quickstart/tracing.md` and one slide under `assets/slides/tracing.html`. Elena: Can you include a tiny CI smoke test that curls the doc and greps for the anchor id so future edits don't regress? Raj: Yep. Example I'll add to docs CI job: ``` # docs anchor smoke test curl -fsS https://docs.redwood.inference/observability/tracing | grep -q 'id="span-ids"' || (echo "missing-anchor" && exit 1) ``` Mei: Also add a changelog line so QA knows this was compatibility work: `docs: restore anchor alias for observability tracing (#PR)` Raj: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3012 1 - frontmatter alias + raw anchor + repo sweep. Pinging @Mei for review. docs-bot: Link-checker queued for PR 3012 :hourglass: will post results here. onboarding-team: Thx — we'll pause the next new-hire run until CI verifies notebook links. Please assign follow-ups to Raj for 48h after merge. Elena: Assigning 48h owner to Raj. Thanks all for the quick turnaround. :white_check_mark:
